component.name: Auto AI Live Caption
component.summary: Real-time speech-to-text live captioning overlay for Linux

description.p: Auto AI Live Caption provides instant, real-time live captioning and subtitle transcription for desktop audio (system audio loopback) and microphones.

ul.li: Zero-latency live streaming tentative preview text in soft blue with white text commitment.
Fully offline Whisper models with one-click in-app model downloads (Tiny, Base, Small).
Ultra-fast cloud Whisper API support (Groq LPU <200ms and OpenAI Whisper).
Minimalist transparent floating glassmorphism overlay with hover auto-hide controls.
Dynamic automatic audio device switching when connecting Bluetooth headsets (TWS).
Native Wayland and X11 support on KDE Plasma and GNOME.

description.p: Initial release of Auto AI Live Caption with real-time in-flight tentative word streaming, model auto-download catalog, and minimalist transparent overlay.
